title: Aadu Puli Attam
desc: An ambitious young man dreams of joining the police force and serving his nation. However, circumstances compel him to rebel and join a gang of notorious criminals.

title: Velainu Vandhutta Vellaikaaran
desc: A minister on his deathbed reveals to an MLA the whereabouts of billions in cash that he has stashed away. However, the minister's relatives are vexed when the MLA loses his memory in an accident.

title: Maaran
desc: Mathimaran, an honest journalist, exposes a fraud by Pazhani, a politician. As a result, it lands his career in trouble, while also threatening his family's safety.

title: Netrikann
desc: Being the prime witness, a former policewoman who cannot see must unveil a horrific case of serial abduction where the culprit has unleashed a reign of terror in the city of Chennai.

title: Premalu
desc: Having been rejected once, Sachin, a young man, falls for Reenu, a girl he meets during a wedding and sets out to win her over.

title: Rakshan the Ghost
desc: A former Interpol officer with a troubled past unleashes his skills in an attempt to protect his beloved family from kidnappers, rivals and death.
